April 21, 2018 - By Evgen Dobrzhanskiy 
Patriot Wealth Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 12.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Patriot Wealth Management Inc bought 12,533 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 113,150 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $19.15M, up from 100,617 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Patriot Wealth Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $840.87 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08 during the last trading session, reaching $165.72. About 60.26M shares traded or 56.69% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
